snapshot.title: Radio: Millbrook Police — Site V-307 Confirmed Secure

fields.orgName: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer

lines.text: Security, this is Sgt. Tanya Reed. We have confirmed that the site at the Hilltop Transmission Main (V-307) was not tampered with. The broken lock on V-307 was caused by a mechanical failure, not by a physical intruder.
The NVR (MBW-NVR-01) is still offline, but the video from CAM-13 (near the site) shows no suspicious activity. The site is now secured. We have no evidence of physical tampering.
The lab has confirmed that no contamination has been detected in manual samples. All results are within normal limits. We recommend continuing verification per the ERP.

fields.voiceStyle: Middle-aged female, calm, professional, slightly weary

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject confirms the absence of physical tampering, reinforcing that the threat is cyber-based. The team must now focus on verifying manual operations and lab results to lift the advisory.
